title: Scheduler
description: Live status of every scheduled trigger — next run time, misfire policy, and retry attempts, refreshed automatically.
disabledDescription: The server has no scheduler wired up. Enable the scheduler capability to see triggers and their next runs here.
emptyDescription: Triggers appear once your app calls scheduleWorkflow() (cron / every / at) in code — Studio only shows their live status here.
lastErrorRestricted: The failure text is hidden for your account. Your workflow writes it while running on the trigger's scheduled input, so it can quote it — which puts it behind the `payloads:read` permission. Your server logs record the failure in full.
